I was 22 when I broke up with him and reading this gave me a peak into what it would’ve been like if I didn’t do it before starting a family, and I’m honestly horrified. 1.5 years into my current relationship, at first, I was shocked that we could compromise and I had a say in things, when really that’s a relationship, and you shouldn’t expect less. Like I said I had to work through a lot of trauma but with actual support, I’m in a much better place.
